title: SLM Intent Parser Harness & Prompt Contracts

harness_execution.name: JSON Schema Conformance & Grammar Harness
harness_execution.pass_criteria: All model completions strictly parse into typed Intent dataclass with zero missing keys.

content_harvesting.sublines: Constraining SLMs to Strict JSON Schemas at 11,000 Feet
talking_points: Architecting zero-hallucination prompt templates with strict JSON grammar boundaries for edge SLMs (Gemma 2B/4B).

Building a dual-layer defensive parser in Pydantic that strips markdown code fences, validates closed enum sets (difficulty, service speed, amenity types), and falls back to safe cruising defaults on malformed completions.
Achieving sub-millisecond on-device intent validation suitable for real-time Bluetooth helmet audio processing in airplane mode.
